fact: By September 2026 Niger had adopted the ordinance of 22 April 2026 on the civil-status regime, its implementing decree of 18 May 2026 and decrees creating the ANEI, with a National Population Register to give each person a unique identifier.
title: Atelier régional de sensibilisation sur les réformes en matière de l'état civil, d'identification des personnes physiques et de modernisation du système national d'identification au Niger
